paper_title: TL;DR Too Long, Do Re-weighting for Effcient LLM Reasoning Compression
caption: Comparison of accuracy and generation length between Vanilla CoT and our method on four benchmark datasets (GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, AMC) using DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen models. consistently reduces generation length while maintaining or improving accuracy across both 7B and 14B model scales.

model_annotations.English: The chart titled “DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B Comparison” illustrates a side-by-side comparison of model accuracy (in percent) between two methods, “Vanilla CoT” and “TLDR (Ours),” across four benchmark datasets. The category axis is the horizontal axis, showing the datasets GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC in left-to-right order with no explicit sorting. The value axis is the vertical axis labeled “Accuracy (%)” on a linear scale spanning 0 to 100, with regularly spaced tick marks at approximately 20-point intervals (0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100). Each dataset has a grouped pair of bars: a light yellow bar for Vanilla CoT and a green bar for TLDR (Ours), placed adjacent within each group. For GSM8K, the Vanilla CoT bar is labeled 89.4, and the TLDR bar is slightly lower with an accompanying red annotation of “-1.7%” above it; for MATH500, the Vanilla CoT bar is labeled 86.8 and the TLDR bar is slightly higher with a green “+0.6%” annotation; for AIME, the Vanilla CoT bar is labeled 42.9 and the TLDR bar is slightly lower with a red “-1.7%” annotation; for AMC, the Vanilla CoT bar is labeled 81.5 and the TLDR bar is slightly higher with a green “+1.6%” annotation. The bars are not stacked, there is a legend at the top identifying the two colors, and the TLDR bars are visually annotated with the percentage-change text (green for positive, red for negative) as the only explicit emphasis.
model_annotations.German: The chart titled “DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B Comparison” illustrates a side-by-side comparison of accuracy between two methods, “Vanilla CoT” and “TLDR (Ours),” across four benchmark datasets. The horizontal axis contains the categorical datasets in left-to-right order GSM8K, MATH500, AIME, and AMC, with no apparent sorting beyond this sequence. The vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy (%)” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with major tick marks shown at regular 20-point intervals (0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100). For each dataset, two adjacent bars are shown: a light/pale yellow bar for “Vanilla CoT” and a medium green bar for “TLDR (Ours),” as indicated by the legend at the top. On GSM8K, the Vanilla CoT bar reaches 89.4%, while the TLDR bar is slightly lower at approximately 87.7%, with a red annotation “-1.7%” above the green bar. On MATH500, the Vanilla CoT bar is 86.8% and the TLDR bar is approximately 87.4%, with a green “+0.6%” annotation. On AIME, the Vanilla CoT bar is 42.9% and the TLDR bar is approximately 41.2%, annotated in red as “-1.7%.” On AMC, the Vanilla CoT bar is 81.5% and the TLDR bar is approximately 83.1%, annotated in green as “+1.6%.” The only visible emphasis beyond color-coding is the per-category percentage-difference annotation placed above the green bars, with negative values in red and positive values in green.
